description: This file is a PHP script that handles AJAX requests related to MoCA diagnostics for a web UI. It manages session authentication, retrieves network configuration data (such as mesh table entries, device info, and associated devices), processes the data, and outputs it as JSON.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the configuration or device data source.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for a given object and parameter list.
